dashboard.costMissing: Batches without costs (more than 3 days after departure)

inventory.title: Stocktake

inventory.foundHereHint: Once confirmed, these boxes move to this warehouse (with a correcting movement)
inventory.missingHintManager: Tick the ones to count as lost — the rest stay as they are

reports.title: Reports

warehouses.title: Warehouses

users.title: Employees

profile.title: Profile
profile.logoutOthers: Sign out on all other devices
profile.telegramSoon: Telegram linking arrives in the next stage
profile.notifHint: Turn off the message types you do not need — the in-app bell still shows everything.

receive.title: Receiving
receive.acceptUnclaimed: Code not found — accept as unidentified cargo
receive.photoUploadFailed: The photo did not upload — check the connection
receive.fileTypeUnsupported: This file type is not supported (allowed: photo, PDF, Excel, Word, TXT, CSV, ZIP, RAR, video)

receive.noWarehouseAssigned: You have no warehouse assigned — contact an administrator
receive.unclaimedMarkingHint: The code written on the cargo — we attach it to a client later

problems.name: fill in the product name
problems.dims: fill in the dimensions and weight (numbers, for example 40 or 8.5)

receipts.title: Receipts
receipts.editWindowClosed: Editing is only open on the day of receiving (after that — manager/logistics)
receipts.structuralLocked: The boxes are already on the move — dimensions and counts can no longer change

receipts.movedReprintHint: reprint the labels — they carry the old warehouse code

crates.title: Crates
crates.dimsHint: Dimensions and weight can be measured and entered after packing
crates.noBoxes: No boxes in the warehouse for this client

errors.multiple_clients: One crate holds the cargo of one client only
errors.unclaimed_not_allowed: Unidentified cargo cannot be packed — assign a client first
errors.box_not_in_stock: The box is not in the warehouse
errors.box_already_crated: The box is already in a crate
errors.box_wrong_warehouse: The box is in another warehouse

plans.title: Load plans
plans.noStock: No free cargo in the warehouse
plans.verdictHint: The agent's answer (the agent does not use the system — logistics records the reply):

errors.crate_not_available: The crate is in another warehouse or already taken

costing.rateHint: Enter how many USD one unit of the currency is worth (CNY ≈ 0.14). A rate is stored with its date — a cost is converted at the rate of its own date.

errors.batch_not_loading: This batch is not being loaded

batches.markSentToAgent: Mark as sent to the agent
batches.departConfirm: Send the truck off? The cargo list is locked after this.

batches.archiveSearch: Batch code, plate number or driver

loading.stickerLostHint: Pick a box from the unscanned ones or enter its code
loading.stockList: Boxes in the warehouse (tap to load):

unloading.autoTransferred: Not on the manifest — accepted and moved to this warehouse:

unloading.stickerLostHint: Pick a box or enter its code
unloading.missingSummary: {n} not unloaded — marked as lost in transit
unloading.foundHereAllConfirm: Confirm that all {n} boxes are in this warehouse?

issue.title: Handover to the client
issue.debtOk: The manager approved (handover to a debtor)
issue.debtNeedsManager: Cargo goes to a debtor only with the manager's approval
issue.debtBlocked: The client is in debt — handover is blocked (the manager must approve)

notifDelivery.title: Telegram delivery log
notifDelivery.note: Failed sends are retried automatically. 'muted' — turned off by the user or Telegram is not linked.

tnved.title: HS codes
tnved.suggestAll: AI suggestion — for the empty ones ({n})
tnved.saved: Codes saved: {n} — these products now fill in automatically
tnved.aiNotConfigured: AI is not configured — ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is not set on the server
tnved.aiFailed: AI did not answer — try later or enter the code by hand
tnved.hint: The AI suggestion is a draft: the final decision is yours. A saved code stays in memory and fills in automatically on the next batches (and on the invoice).

finance.title: Finance
finance.balanceHint: Balance = charges − payments (USD). Positive means the client owes.
finance.fxMissing: There is no rate for this currency — add one under Exchange rates first
finance.pricingHint: After customs clearance, enter the agreed price for each client — it goes onto their balance as a charge.

map.title: Map
map.disclaimer: For trucks with the driver's phone connected the position is real (updated every 2–3 hours). For the rest it is estimated from typical travel times; the 📍 buttons on the batch page correct it.
map.noTrucks: No trucks on the road right now.
map.basemapMissing: The detailed map is not loaded yet — run `bash ops/fetch-basemap.sh` on the server and this drawing turns into a real map.

accounting.title: Management accounting
accounting.pnlNote: In the monthly table revenue and costs each land on their own date. For what a trip actually earned, see the Profit by batch report.
accounting.transfersExcluded: {n} transfers between our own accounts were excluded (they are neither income nor spending).
accounting.uzsNote: Amount in UZS at today's rate ({rate})
accounting.fxMissing: No rate for this currency — enter one under Exchange rates first
accounting.cashNote: Untick «Cash» for an expense that never moves money (depreciation): it belongs in the P&L but stays out of the cash flow.
accounting.sameAccount: Cannot transfer to the same account
accounting.needTwoAccounts: At least two accounts are needed
